objective: Verify whether the product 'Mellerud Bio MEL 233-MOB Cleaning Liquid' has both cleaner type 'multi surface cleaner' and 'floor cleaner' as claimed, and report the result.

params.product_sku: lookup from product_variants WHERE brand='Mellerud' AND series='Bio MEL 233-MOB' AND model='Cleaning Liquid' to get product_sku
params.product_record_path: lookup from product_variants WHERE brand='Mellerud' AND series='Bio MEL 233-MOB' AND model='Cleaning Liquid' to get record_path
params.cleaner_type_value: lookup from product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku=$product_sku AND property_key='cleaner type' to get property_value_text

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Checked product {product_sku}: claim that it has both cleaner types is absent. Answer: <NO>
